description.content: Retrieve a paginated list of refresh tokens for a specific user, with optional filtering by client ID. Results are sorted by credential_id ascending.

query.description: (Required) ID of the user whose refresh tokens to retrieve. Required.
Filter results by client ID. Only valid when user_id is provided.
An opaque cursor from which to start the selection (exclusive). Expires after 24 hours. Obtained from the next property of a previous response.
Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.
Comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude (based on value provided for include_fields) in the result. Leave empty to retrieve all fields.
Whether specified fields are to be included (true) or excluded (false).
